title: The Relationship Bonus as a Portfolio Benefit on Savings and Money Market Accounts
content:
The relationship bonus on Savings & Money Market Accounts is a portfolio benefit rather than a benefit of a single account: it is earned because of the whole relationship the customer holds with Piedmont Crescent Bank, and it is settled on each savings account separately.

**In force — the holding condition.** The relationship bonus is paid only while the customer holds, at the start of the day, an active checking account whose tier is listed among the savings account's qualifying checking tiers. The holding is read from the bank's record of the customer's checking accounts as at the start of that day, not from what the customer states about their accounts elsewhere.

**In force — accounts outside the benefit.** An account whose tier lists no qualifying checking tier, or whose relationship bonus rate is 0.00 percentage points, takes no part in that allocation and consumes none of that cap.

**In force — how the bonus is credited.** The bonus is credited as its own interest credit entry, carrying the relationship bonus component, at statement cycle close.

**No longer in force.** The clause that allocated the benefit day by day across the customer's eligible savings balances — taking them in order of balance, highest first with ties going to the earlier opened account, and paying the bonus on each account's balance only until the running combined total reached that account's relationship bonus balance cap, so that balance above the running cap earned no bonus — is no longer in force. It has been superseded by the basis on which relationship bonus owed for a closed statement cycle is now settled, and it is not to be applied to any account of this product.

### Points of judgement

*Whose checking account satisfies the holding condition?* An active checking account held by the same customer, of a tier that appears on the qualifying list the savings account's own tier carries. Which tiers those are is set in the bonus yield parameters of the savings tier held.

*At what moment is the holding read?* At the start of the day for which the bonus is being paid.

superseded_clauses: Each day, the customer's savings balances eligible for the bonus are taken in the order given by savings_msr_combined_bonus_base, highest balance first and ties to the earlier opened_date, and the bonus is paid on each account's balance only until the running combined total reaches that account's relationship_bonus_balance_cap; balance above the running cap earns no bonus.
